entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, VeloFit ID 401. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about a jersey I bought a while back. I'd like to return it if possible.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's more of a preference. It turned out to be the wrong size. I finally got around to properly trying it on for a ride and it's just too tight for comfort. I was hoping to exchange it.
I see. Sizing can be tricky. Do you have your order number so I can check the purchase date?
Sure, it's VF-9917-B. It was a couple of months ago.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order was delivered 79 days ago. You're in luck! Our policy for standard apparel is 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately.

That's great, I appreciate it. Now, since I'm processing this as a return and will need to place a new order for the exchange, and given I'm a pretty frequent customer, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my trouble?

That's a reasonable request. Let me just review your account history... I see you're one of our VIP customers. For your loyalty, I can absolutely offer you a 15% discount on your next order. I can add that code to the return confirmation email.
Perfect, that's exactly what I was hoping for. Thank you for being so helpful, Diana.

You're very welcome. It's our pleasure to take care of our best customers. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with the shipping label and that 15% discount code within the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can do for you?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
